results_section: 1. Without reasoning LLMs, diversity of 16 models and methods increases performance from the blue dotted line (53%) to the orange dotted line (69.5%).
2. Diversity of 16 models and methods solves 26.5% of the puzzles on which reasoning LLMs fail. These 34/400 puzzles are between the dotted purple line (91.5%) and the black line (100%).
3. Diversity of 16 models and methods solves 80% of the puzzles on which 948 humans collectively fail. These 5/400 puzzles are between the dotted green line (98.8%) and the black line (100%).
